_comment: SATELLITE VIEW (2026-10-15): the observing satellites whose OWN imagery NEXUM can show, keyed by NORAD catalogue number. Data, not UI code. One entry = one satellite and the products that come from it alone (a layer, a platform filter, a stream): never the product of another satellite. 'swath_km' is the instrument's nominal swath (a theoretical field, said as such); 'cmr' is the NASA CMR collection whose newest granule proves the instrument is still delivering (checked at run time, never assumed). Services already in media-hosts.json: NASA GIBS (WMS + WMTS), EUMETView, CMR, Earth Search, youtube-nocookie.
